name: Crossbones

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

signatureAbility:
Hydra Training
Brock Rumlow's brutal Hydra Training allows him a [40 - 90]% chance to Purify incoming Debuffs. Each time he does so, he gains a Fury Buff. Chance temporarily decreases for consecutive triggers.
immunityDetails:
• %90 Arındırma (oran giderek azalır) 💪🏼
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Punisher 2099) 🔮

abilitySections.title: Personal Fury Buffs
content: Unless otherwise stated, Crossbones' Fury Buffs grant +[4,663.8] Attack Rating for 9 seconds. These Fury Buffs gain increased Potency equal to 20% of Crossbones's Critical Damage Multiplier.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hit Replacement
content: Crossbones' hydraulic gauntlets prevent him from landing Critical Hits. Whenever he would land one, he instead gains a Fury Buff.

abilitySections.title: Contempt for Heroes
content: While fighting #Hero Champions, Crossbones' abilities gain special Contempt bonuses.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Reduce the opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by 20% for each Fury Buff active. Contempt: Reduction becomes 25% instead.

abilitySections.title: Overrun - Dash Back and Hold Block for 1.2 Seconds
content: Once activated, Overrun remains active for 12 seconds, after which it must go on cooldown for 8 seconds.
On Activation: Refresh the duration of all Personal Fury Buffs and gain 2 new ones. Contempt: Gain an additional Fury Buff.
While Active: Hits on the opponent ignore positive Physical Resistance and gain +50% Combat Power Rate.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Spend 1 Fury Buff to Pause all remaining Fury Buffs for 5 seconds. If this attack Intercepts the opponent or strikes them while they are recovering from a Special Attack, it does not cost a Fury Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff.
Contempt: Gain 2 an additional Fury Buff(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [10,364] Energy Damage over 8 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.
Contempt: Inflict an additional Incinerate Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain a Precision Buff, increasing Critical Rating by +[916.67] for 40 seconds.
Contempt: Precision Buff becomes Passive and lasts 70 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Hydra Training
content: Brock Rumlow's brutal Hydra Training allows him a [40 - 90]% chance to Purify incoming Debuffs. Each time he does so, he gains a Fury Buff. Chance temporarily decreases for consecutive triggers.
